==Overview==
=== Format ===
* Two groups of six teams each
* Groups based on [[LPL/2016 Season/Spring Season|Spring Season]] performances
** One team from Tier 1 ([[Royal Never Give Up]] and [[EDward Gaming]])
** Two teams from Tier 2 ([[Team WE]], [[Newbee]], [[Snake eSports]], and [[Vici Gaming]])
** Two teams from Tier 3 ([[LGD Gaming]], [[Invictus Gaming]], [[Oh My God]], and [[Game Talents]])
** One team from Tier 4 ([[Saint Club]] and [[I May]])
* Each team plays 16 matches.
** Double Round Robin within own group
** Single Round Robin against other group
* Best of 3
* Top 4 from each group qualifies to the [[LPL/2016 Season/Summer Playoffs|playoffs]]
* Group winners receive playoff byes into the semifinals
* Second place teams receive playoff byes into the quarterfinals
